findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without snapshots
findings.description: With snapshot_retention_limit absent or 0, automated snapshots are disabled and cache data cannot be restored after loss.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without transit encryption
findings.description: With transit_encryption_enabled absent or false, data in transit between the application and the cache is unencrypted.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without at-rest encryption
findings.description: With at_rest_encryption_enabled absent or false, cached data and snapshots are stored unencrypted.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without Multi-AZ / failover
findings.description: Hygiene: ElastiCache replication groups should enable Multi-AZ with automatic failover for high availability. Set multi_az_enabled = true and automatic_failover_enabled = true.

findings.title: IAM user uses an inline policy
findings.description: The user embeds an inline policy document instead of attaching a managed policy. Inline policies cannot be reused, versioned, or reviewed centrally. Prefer aws_iam_policy with aws_iam_user_policy_attachment.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: IAM user has no tags
findings.description: The IAM user carries no tags, making ownership, purpose, and lifecycle untraceable in audits and complicating attribute-based access control. Tag identities with at least owner and purpose.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without snapshot retention
findings.description: snapshot_retention_limit is absent or 0 on the replication group, so no automated snapshots are kept and the dataset cannot be restored after corruption or accidental flush.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.
